what_happened: Settled the CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR gating question by live, reversible experiment against this repo's own deployed .claude/settings.json (temporary hook registration, trigger, observe, revert, diff-verify restored) rather than relying on docs alone; confirmed across PreToolUse:Bash and PostToolUse:Write, including the nested bash -c shape, and confirmed the fixed form still blocks git add -A with exit 2.

Operator directed mid-implementation that the migration script for already-deployed repos (Phase 3), its test (Phase 4), and the real-deploy migration demonstration (Phase 6) be dropped from scope, because the operator is separately reloading/redeploying the agent system to every consumer repo directly, superseding the install-once-cannot-reach-already-deployed-repo premise. All three phases were closed [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] with the operator instruction recorded as the Reasoned Exclusions evidence; a draft migration script that had already been written and smoke-tested was deleted (never committed). Acceptance criteria 1/2/5 are not satisfied by this task; criterion 4 is unaffected.

Task 364's postflight completion write was refused by the completion-deploy gate (exit 6): the deployed .claude/ tree was stale relative to the source store at completion time. Deferred to the next cycle's Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint to deploy and reconcile.
